_read_me: Figures for /impact/. Leave a value null until it has been counted; the page then shows 'Being collected' instead of a number. Never estimate. After editing, run: python3 build/growth-pages/build_pages.py

visitors.source: GoatCounter (theimr.goatcounter.com), unique visitors in the period

visitor_countries.source: GoatCounter, countries with at least one visit in the period

ask_questions.source: GoatCounter events starting with event/ask (country and topic only; the questions themselves are never stored)

clinic_drafts.source: Rights communications prepared with the Legal Clinic tool and sent to the Clinic (Clinic log)

_citations_example.title: Author, Title, Journal or report, year

_stories_example.title: Short title
_stories_example.text: Two or three sentences, anonymized, published with written consent
